summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K confirming completion of its acquisition of Webster Financial Corporation on 20 August 2026, following inside-information notices dated 3 February, 23 April and 5 August 2026. Concurrently, the EUR 3.559bn non-cash capital increase approved at the 27 March 2026 AGM was executed, issuing 329,846,438 new shares at EUR 10.7896 each, roughly 2.2455% of pre-deal capital and 2.1962% post. Capital now stands at EUR 7.5096bn across 15,019,165,940 shares. Listing and registry registration were requested; no advisor or premium disclosed.
